plainTranslation: Directly opposing drives. You want the same intensity aimed in opposite directions - magnetic and exhausting. Failure mode: every difference becomes a contest. Take turns leading, agree on direction first, and stop treating the relationship as a fight to win.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry aspect material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
